title: Dragons, Cryptids, and Dinos, OH MY!
description: Learn how to craft vibrant, exotic creature characters for your stories and artwork by studying zoology, paleontology, folklore, history, and a menagerie of other authors’ work. We will also dissect a dragon—from inspiration, to designing, to writing his story and crafting a maquette for drawing. A Q and A will follow.

title: Let's get Drafting Cosplay Part Dues: Making your custom sloper. The basis to all pattern making.
description: We will take you from your measurements to a Sloper. The base custom patern that will make that cosplay fit you to a T. During the panel we will walk through the steps of making a sloper, and how it is used to modify any pattern you have to fit you and your body shape. A handout will be given of common pattern formulas.

title: How to Make an Animated Short Film
description: This panel would include a concise glimpse into the animation pipeline for a short animated film made by only a few people, utilizing samples from my own animated films. This will be a great panel for artists, students and all animation enthusiasts alike to see what goes into making your own animated short film.

title: Devil’s Advocate: How to Write a “Good” Villain
description: A hero is only as good as their villain, and the best villains are the ones we love to hate. But how do you avoid the pitfalls of making your villain too flat, or too lame, or “evil for the sake of being evil”? In this lecture we’ll discuss the morals, motives, and modus opperandi of some famous villains, the nuances of antiheros, antagonists, and villains, and how to cut Satan a break—there are much more interesting and sinister figures for inspiration for your big baddies. A Q and A will follow.

title: Your Brother, Theo. — Filmmaking in PA!
participants: Bryant Eberhart (Writer & Director), Matt Jacobs (Director of Photography), Mason Keeler (Composer)
description: Your Brother, Theo.' is a 2026 coming of age Short Film, Written & Directed by Bryant Eberhart. It was entirely shot in PA, specifically in Altoona & Duncansville. Come check out a Sneak Peek of the film & join the conversation about the opportunities of filmmaking right here in PA. Questions are definitely welcome!

title: Creative Writing Soundboard
description: Are you a writer trying to figure out how to add emotional depth to your characters? Need to untangle a plot knot? Got an OC or a story seed you want to get feedback on, or just share with your fellow creatives? Maybe you have questions about how to share your work, whether through traditional publishing or the indie publishing route? Scifi Valley Con is a hub of creative folks, so let’s share what we’re working on with our community! This roundtable will be moderated by JD Donnelly, experienced artist and writer behind Painting Dragon Feathers, and author of CryptoZoo, with other talented authors on our panel. And if we can’t help with your questions, maybe your fellow con-goers can!
